earphone.en: She used one earphone so she could still hear the teacher's instructions.
earphone.zh: 她只戴一邊耳機，這樣仍能聽見老師的指示。

earring.en: She found a silver earring under the desk after class.
earring.zh: 她下課後在桌子下找到一只銀色耳環。

eccentric.en: The inventor became famous for his eccentric ideas and unusual experiments.
eccentric.zh: 那位發明家因古怪的想法和不尋常的實驗而出名。

echo.en: Our voices produced an echo inside the long stone tunnel.
echo.zh: 我們的聲音在長長的石造隧道裡產生回音。

eclipse.en: The science club gathered outside to observe the lunar eclipse.
eclipse.zh: 科學社到戶外集合，觀察月食。

ecological.en: The report examines the ecological effects of building near the wetland.
ecological.zh: 這份報告探討在濕地附近興建工程的生態影響。

ecology.en: She studies ecology to understand how organisms interact with their environment.
ecology.zh: 她研究生態學，以了解生物如何與環境互動。

economical.en: Taking the bus is often more economical than traveling by taxi.
economical.zh: 搭公車通常比搭計程車更經濟。

economics.en: The course introduces basic economics through examples from everyday life.
economics.zh: 這門課透過日常生活的例子介紹基礎經濟學。

economist.en: An economist explained why prices may rise when demand increases quickly.
economist.zh: 一位經濟學家解釋需求快速增加時價格為何可能上升。

ecosystem.en: Removing one species can affect the balance of an entire ecosystem.
ecosystem.zh: 移除一個物種可能影響整個生態系統的平衡。

edible.en: The guide showed us which wild plants were edible and which were not.
edible.zh: 嚮導告訴我們哪些野生植物可以食用、哪些不行。

editorial.en: The newspaper published an editorial about improving public transportation.
editorial.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於改善大眾運輸的社論。

ego.en: A strong ego can make it harder to accept useful criticism.
ego.zh: 過強的自我可能讓人更難接受有用的批評。

elastic.en: This elastic band can stretch without breaking under normal use.
elastic.zh: 這條橡皮筋在正常使用下可以伸長而不斷裂。

elbow.en: He rested his elbow on the desk while reading the article.
elbow.zh: 他閱讀文章時把手肘靠在桌上。

elder.en: The village elder shared stories about how the community had changed.
elder.zh: 村中的長者分享了社區如何改變的故事。

electrician.en: An electrician inspected the damaged wiring before the classroom reopened.
electrician.zh: 教室重新開放前，一位電工檢查了受損的電線。

electronics.en: The store sells electronics such as headphones, tablets, and small speakers.
electronics.zh: 這家店販售耳機、平板和小型喇叭等電子產品。

elegant.en: The bridge has an elegant design that combines strength with simplicity.
elegant.zh: 這座橋的設計優雅，兼具堅固與簡潔。

elephant.en: An elephant can communicate with other members of its herd over long distances.
elephant.zh: 大象可以和遠距離外的象群成員溝通。

elevate.en: The new platform will elevate the equipment above possible floodwater.
elevate.zh: 新的平台會把設備抬高到可能的洪水水位之上。

elevator.en: The elevator stopped on every floor during the busy morning period.
elevator.zh: 早上繁忙時段，電梯每一層都停。

eligible.en: Students with enough credits are eligible to apply for the program.
eligible.zh: 學分足夠的學生有資格申請這項計畫。

eloquent.en: Her eloquent speech made a complex issue easier to understand.
eloquent.zh: 她流暢有說服力的演說讓複雜議題更容易理解。

elsewhere.en: The library was full, so we decided to study elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 圖書館坐滿了，所以我們決定到別處讀書。

embarrassment.en: He laughed at his small mistake instead of letting embarrassment ruin the presentation.
embarrassment.zh: 他對自己的小錯誤一笑置之，沒有讓尷尬毀掉簡報。

embassy.en: Travelers contacted the embassy for updated information about local regulations.
embassy.zh: 旅客聯絡大使館，以取得當地規定的最新資訊。

embrace.en: The school decided to embrace new technology while keeping effective traditional methods.
embrace.zh: 學校決定接受新科技，同時保留有效的傳統方法。

emigrant.en: The novel follows an emigrant who builds a new life overseas.
emigrant.zh: 這本小說描述一名移民在海外建立新生活的故事。

emigrate.en: Many families chose to emigrate because they hoped for better opportunities abroad.
emigrate.zh: 許多家庭選擇移居海外，希望獲得更好的機會。

emigration.en: Economic change contributed to increased emigration from the region during that decade.
emigration.zh: 經濟變化使那十年間該地區的移民人數增加。

emission.en: The factory installed new equipment to reduce carbon emission from its operations.
emission.zh: 工廠安裝新設備，以減少營運產生的碳排放。

emperor.en: The museum displayed letters written during the reign of the emperor.
emperor.zh: 博物館展出那位皇帝在位期間寫下的信件。

emphasis.en: The teacher placed special emphasis on checking evidence before making conclusions.
emphasis.zh: 老師特別強調在下結論前要先檢查證據。

empire.en: The ancient empire controlled trade routes across a large area.
empire.zh: 那個古代帝國控制了大片區域的貿易路線。

enclose.en: Please enclose a copy of the form with your application.
enclose.zh: 請在申請資料中附上一份表格副本。

encouragement.en: A few words of encouragement helped her continue after a difficult week.
encouragement.zh: 幾句鼓勵的話幫助她在艱難的一週後繼續努力。

encyclopedia.en: The student used an encyclopedia to confirm several background facts.
encyclopedia.zh: 那名學生使用百科全書確認幾項背景事實。

endanger.en: Polluting the river could endanger animals that depend on clean water.
endanger.zh: 污染河流可能危害依賴乾淨水源的動物。

endeavor.en: The research project was a joint endeavor involving several schools.
endeavor.zh: 這項研究計畫是數所學校共同投入的合作成果。

ending.en: The unexpected ending changed how readers understood the whole story.
ending.zh: 出乎意料的結局改變了讀者對整個故事的理解。

endorse.en: Several teachers endorse the new reading program after reviewing its results.
endorse.zh: 幾位老師檢視成果後支持這項新的閱讀計畫。

endorsement.en: The proposal gained public endorsement after its benefits became clearer.
endorsement.zh: 這項提案的好處更清楚後，獲得了大眾支持。

endowment.en: The university used its endowment to support scholarships and research.
endowment.zh: 大學利用基金支持獎學金與研究。

endurance.en: Long-distance running requires both physical endurance and careful pacing.
endurance.zh: 長跑需要體力耐力，也需要適當配速。

enemy.en: In the story, the former enemy later becomes an unexpected ally.
enemy.zh: 在故事中，原本的敵人後來成為意想不到的盟友。

energetic.en: The energetic students volunteered to organize games for the school festival.
energetic.zh: 充滿活力的學生自願為校慶安排遊戲。

enforcement.en: Stronger enforcement of traffic rules reduced dangerous driving near the school.
enforcement.zh: 加強交通規則的執法，減少了學校附近的危險駕駛。

engagement.en: Student engagement increased when the lesson included discussion and hands-on activities.
engagement.zh: 課程加入討論與實作活動後，學生參與度提高了。

enhancement.en: The software update includes an enhancement that makes searching much faster.
enhancement.zh: 這次軟體更新包含一項改良，讓搜尋速度快很多。

enjoyable.en: The review session became more enjoyable after the teacher added a quiz game.
enjoyable.zh: 老師加入問答遊戲後，複習課變得更有趣。

enjoyment.en: Her enjoyment of reading grew after she discovered historical novels.
enjoyment.zh: 她發現歷史小說後，對閱讀的樂趣增加了。

enlarge.en: You can enlarge the image to examine the small labels more clearly.
enlarge.zh: 你可以放大圖片，更清楚查看小標示。

enlargement.en: The enlargement of the photo revealed details that were hard to notice before.
enlargement.zh: 照片放大後，顯示出先前不容易注意到的細節。

enlighten.en: The documentary may enlighten viewers about how coral reefs support marine life.
enlighten.zh: 這部紀錄片可以讓觀眾更了解珊瑚礁如何支持海洋生物。

enlightenment.en: The course encouraged enlightenment through questioning, evidence, and open discussion.
enlightenment.zh: 這門課透過提問、證據與開放討論促進理解與啟發。

enrich.en: Reading widely can enrich your vocabulary and improve your writing.
enrich.zh: 廣泛閱讀可以豐富詞彙並提升寫作能力。

enrichment.en: The school offers enrichment activities for students interested in science and art.
enrichment.zh: 學校為對科學與藝術有興趣的學生提供延伸學習活動。

enroll.en: Students can enroll in the course after completing the required form.
enroll.zh: 學生填完必要表格後即可註冊這門課。

enrollment.en: Enrollment increased after the school introduced more elective courses.
enrollment.zh: 學校增加更多選修課後，註冊人數上升了。

enterprise.en: The small enterprise grew steadily by focusing on reliable service.
enterprise.zh: 這家小型企業靠著可靠服務穩定成長。

enthusiasm.en: Her enthusiasm for science inspired several classmates to join the club.
enthusiasm.zh: 她對科學的熱情鼓舞幾位同學加入社團。

enthusiastic.en: The class gave an enthusiastic response to the new group project.
enthusiastic.zh: 全班對新的小組專題給予熱烈回應。

entitle.en: Completing the program will entitle students to receive a certificate.
entitle.zh: 完成這項計畫後，學生將有資格獲得證書。

entrepreneur.en: The entrepreneur started a small company that designs reusable containers.
entrepreneur.zh: 那位創業家成立了一家設計可重複使用容器的小公司。

envelope.en: She placed the application form inside a large envelope before mailing it.
envelope.zh: 她把申請表放進大信封後寄出。

envious.en: He felt envious at first, but later congratulated his friend's success.
envious.zh: 他一開始有些羨慕，但後來仍向朋友的成功道賀。

envision.en: The planners envision a greener neighborhood with more parks and bike lanes.
envision.zh: 規劃者構想一個有更多公園與自行車道的綠色社區。

envy.en: Constant envy can distract people from appreciating their own progress.
envy.zh: 持續的嫉妒可能讓人忽略自己的進步。

epidemic.en: Public health officials studied the epidemic to understand how it spread.
epidemic.zh: 公共衛生人員研究這場流行病，以了解它如何傳播。

episode.en: The final episode explains what happened to each main character.
episode.zh: 最後一集說明每個主要角色後來發生了什麼。

equality.en: The discussion focused on equality of opportunity in education.
equality.zh: 討論聚焦在教育機會平等。

equalize.en: The new funding plan aims to equalize resources among different schools.
equalize.zh: 新的資助計畫旨在讓不同學校之間的資源更平均。

equation.en: The teacher showed us how to solve the equation step by step.
equation.zh: 老師一步一步示範如何解這個方程式。

equity.en: The policy emphasizes equity by giving extra support where needs are greater.
equity.zh: 這項政策重視公平，在需求較大的地方提供更多支持。

era.en: The invention marked the beginning of a new era in communication.
era.zh: 這項發明象徵通訊新時代的開始。

erase.en: Use a pencil so you can erase mistakes easily while drafting.
erase.zh: 起草時用鉛筆，這樣可以輕鬆擦掉錯誤。

erect.en: Workers will erect a temporary stage in front of the auditorium.
erect.zh: 工作人員會在禮堂前搭建臨時舞台。

erosion.en: Planting grass can reduce soil erosion on steep slopes.
erosion.zh: 在陡坡種草可以減少土壤侵蝕。

errand.en: She stopped at the bookstore while running an errand for her teacher.
errand.zh: 她替老師辦事時順道去了書店。

error.en: The program displayed an error after the file name was entered incorrectly.
error.zh: 檔名輸入錯誤後，程式顯示一則錯誤訊息。

essence.en: The summary captures the essence of the argument in just two sentences.
essence.zh: 這份摘要只用兩句話就掌握了論點的核心。

estate.en: The old estate has been converted into a public museum.
estate.zh: 那座老莊園已改建成公共博物館。

eternal.en: The poem explores the human wish for eternal peace and lasting memory.
eternal.zh: 這首詩探討人們對永恆和平與長久記憶的渴望。

ethics.en: The class discussed ethics in scientific research and the treatment of participants.
ethics.zh: 全班討論科學研究中的倫理以及如何對待研究參與者。

ethnic.en: The festival celebrates music and food from several ethnic communities.
ethnic.zh: 這場節慶慶祝來自不同族群社區的音樂與食物。

evacuate.en: Students practiced how to evacuate the building safely during an emergency drill.
evacuate.zh: 學生練習在緊急演練中如何安全撤離建築物。

evacuation.en: The evacuation proceeded calmly because everyone followed the safety instructions.
evacuation.zh: 因為大家都遵守安全指示，撤離過程很平穩。

evaluate.en: The committee will evaluate each proposal before making a final decision.
evaluate.zh: 委員會會評估每項提案後再做最後決定。

evaluation.en: The teacher's evaluation included comments on both strengths and areas for improvement.
evaluation.zh: 老師的評量包含優點以及需要改進之處的意見。

evaporate.en: Water will evaporate faster when the air is warm and dry.
evaporate.zh: 空氣溫暖且乾燥時，水會蒸發得更快。

evaporation.en: Higher temperatures usually increase the rate of evaporation from open water.
evaporation.zh: 較高溫度通常會加快開放水面的蒸發速度。

eve.en: The town square became crowded on the eve of the festival.
eve.zh: 節慶前夕，鎮上的廣場變得非常熱鬧。

eventual.en: Their eventual success came after several failed attempts and careful revisions.
eventual.zh: 他們經過幾次失敗和仔細修正後，最終取得成功。

evident.en: It became evident that the original plan needed several changes.
evident.zh: 很明顯原本的計畫需要做幾項修改。

evil.en: The novel avoids a simple division between good and evil characters.
evil.zh: 這本小說避免把角色簡單分成善與惡。

evolution.en: The exhibit explains the evolution of communication from letters to smartphones.
evolution.zh: 展覽說明通訊方式從書信到智慧型手機的演變。

evolve.en: Languages evolve as speakers create new words and change old expressions.
evolve.zh: 語言會隨著使用者創造新詞並改變舊表達而演變。

exaggerate.en: Do not exaggerate the results when the evidence is still limited.
exaggerate.zh: 證據仍有限時，不要誇大研究結果。

exaggeration.en: The headline was an exaggeration that made the story sound more dramatic.
exaggeration.zh: 那個標題有些誇大，讓故事聽起來更戲劇化。

exceed.en: The final cost should not exceed the budget approved by the committee.
exceed.zh: 最後成本不應超過委員會核准的預算。

excellence.en: The award recognizes excellence in both academic work and community service.
excellence.zh: 這個獎項表揚在學業與社區服務上的傑出表現。

exception.en: Everyone must follow the rule, with one exception for medical needs.
exception.zh: 每個人都必須遵守規定，只有醫療需求可作例外。

exceptional.en: Her exceptional performance earned praise from both teachers and classmates.
exceptional.zh: 她出色的表現獲得老師和同學的稱讚。

excess.en: The body stores some excess energy for later use.
excess.zh: 身體會儲存部分多餘能量以供之後使用。

excessive.en: Excessive screen time can interfere with sleep and concentration.
excessive.zh: 過多的螢幕使用時間可能影響睡眠與專注力。

exclude.en: The study will exclude incomplete responses from the final analysis.
exclude.zh: 這項研究會把不完整的回答排除在最後分析之外。

exclusion.en: The policy was revised to prevent unfair exclusion from school activities.
exclusion.zh: 這項政策經過修訂，以防止學生被不公平地排除在校內活動之外。

exclusive.en: The interview includes exclusive information that was not released earlier.
exclusive.zh: 這篇訪談包含先前尚未公開的獨家資訊。

execute.en: The team must execute the plan carefully to avoid unnecessary delays.
execute.zh: 團隊必須仔細執行計畫，以避免不必要的延誤。

execution.en: Good execution is as important as a strong idea in a group project.
execution.zh: 在小組專題中，良好的執行和好的想法同樣重要。

exemplify.en: These two examples exemplify the difference between formal and informal writing.
exemplify.zh: 這兩個例子具體呈現正式與非正式寫作之間的差異。

exempt.en: Students with approved medical reasons may be exempt from the activity.
exempt.zh: 有核准醫療理由的學生可以免參加這項活動。

exemption.en: The school granted an exemption after reviewing the student's documents.
exemption.zh: 學校審查學生文件後批准了豁免。

exert.en: The heavy box can exert considerable pressure on the weak shelf.
exert.zh: 這個重箱子會對脆弱的架子施加相當大的壓力。

exhaust.en: Long hours without rest can exhaust even highly motivated students.
exhaust.zh: 長時間不休息，即使很有動力的學生也會精疲力竭。

exhaustion.en: She recognized the signs of exhaustion and decided to rest earlier.
exhaustion.zh: 她察覺到疲憊的徵兆，決定提早休息。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit student artwork throughout the summer.
exhibit.zh: 博物館將在整個夏季展出學生作品。

exhibition.en: The science exhibition attracted visitors from several nearby schools.
exhibition.zh: 這場科學展覽吸引了附近數所學校的參觀者。

exile.en: The historical figure spent many years in exile before returning home.
exile.zh: 那位歷史人物流亡多年後才返回家鄉。

existence.en: Scientists found new evidence supporting the existence of water beneath the surface.
existence.zh: 科學家找到支持地表下存在水的新證據。

exotic.en: The garden contains several exotic plants from tropical regions.
exotic.zh: 這座花園裡有幾種來自熱帶地區的外來植物。

expand.en: The school plans to expand the library by adding more study areas.
expand.zh: 學校計畫增加更多自習區來擴建圖書館。

expansion.en: The expansion of the railway shortened travel time between the two cities.
expansion.zh: 鐵路擴建縮短了兩座城市之間的旅行時間。

expedition.en: The research team prepared carefully for an expedition to the remote island.
expedition.zh: 研究團隊為前往偏遠島嶼的考察做了充分準備。

expertise.en: The project benefited from her expertise in data analysis and statistics.
expertise.zh: 這項專題受益於她在資料分析與統計方面的專業。

expire.en: This temporary pass will expire at the end of the month.
expire.zh: 這張臨時通行證會在月底到期。

expiry.en: Check the expiry date before submitting the document for verification.
expiry.zh: 送交文件驗證前，先確認到期日。
